title: Dot-grid figures reach for a glowing mark, then type
summary: A glowing app mark spins in on black while two dot-column figures slide in from the edges and reach for it; the scene loses its light, an offer line and a grey sub-line blur in, then a URL is typed on a silent black end.
use_when: a short silent teaser for a service or agency offer with a single promise
opening a film with a premium mark moment before any UI exists
a dark brand with a strong single-colour icon (blue, cyan, violet)
muted autoplay feeds where the copy must carry the offer

look.type_style: semibold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, ~7 % of frame height, period on each line; sub-line same size in mid grey; URL in the same face, white, lower case

structure.shot: app mark centred on black spins from near edge-on to face-on and grows; two dot-column figures slide in from left and right edges, fingers pointing at it
structure.camera: static frame; mark width 34 -> 110 px (720p) over 60 fr
structure.motion: mark rotateY ~80 -> 0 deg + scale, easings.outQuint 60 fr (50 % by f18, 90 % by f40, no overshoot); figures slide 36 % W f15 -> f66, easings.outQuint 51 fr; halo light-on f15 -> f54 lagging the mark

structure.shot: hold: lit mark dead centre with blue halo, the two figures' fingertips almost touching it
structure.motion: figures drift back 1.5 % W over 40 fr, easings.inOutSine; dot columns flicker 40-100 % per column

structure.shot: lights off: figures and halo fade out, the mark tilts away and darkens to black
structure.motion: halo + figures to black 15 fr (f105 -> f120), easings.inOutSine; mark tilts away and dims core -> deep blue (f127) -> black (f135), 30 fr; 5 fr of pure black

structure.shot: offer statement, 6 words, white, centred on black
structure.motion: whole line blur-in from black, blur + fade 24 fr (f136 -> f160), easings.outQuint; holds

structure.shot: grey sub-line, 5 words, the guarantee, appears under the offer; the pair re-centres, then both fade out
structure.motion: sub-line blur-in ~15 fr (6.27 -> 6.77, ±0.25 s), first line rises ~4 % H on springs.ui to re-centre the pair; both fade out ~8 fr after 8.00 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: URL, 19 characters, typed on black, left edge fixed at the final centred position; holds ~2 s
structure.motion: typewriter steady ~3 fr/char from sheets (2 chars at 8.50, 17 at 10.00, complete by 10.27; human 30 fps pass: 2.5 fr/char), no caret; hold ~60 fr to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: mark (rounded app icon reads best), accent for halo and dots, bg near black, fg, muted for the sub-line
params.content.figure: PNG/SVG silhouette sampled into dot columns for the two side figures (mirrored), e.g. reaching hands
params.content.statement: offer line, <= 7 words, ends in a period
params.content.sub: grey guarantee line under it, <= 6 words
params.content.url: URL typed at the end, <= 24 chars
params.particles.pitch: column pitch in px at 720p (default 10), dot 2 px, vertical pitch 3 px
params.timing.charFrames: frames per typed character at 30 fps (default 2.6; sheets read ~3)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: No cuts: one continuous shot split at state changes. Measured at 30 fps by a human pass: mark 34 -> 110 px over 60 fr outQuint, no overshoot; figures 36 % W in 51 fr then drift back 1.5 % over 40 fr; halo #000420 -> #02164A over ~36 fr; lights-off halo 15 fr, mark 30 fr, 5 fr black; text blur-in 24 fr; URL 19 chars ~2.5-2.6 fr/char, no caret. Dots are a column grid (pitch 10 px at 720p, dot 2 px, ~3 px vertical pitch), cyan core to blue edge, per-column brightness 40-100 %. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): lights-off, mark-spin-in, dot-column-figure. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
